def test_minidmap_clean_on_gc(capsys):
    # Exercises MinIDMap._clean, which prints the freed id and recycles it.
    m = MinIDMap()
    a = _WeakObj()
    b = _WeakObj()
    id_a = m.get(a)
    id_b = m.get(b)
    assert (id_a, id_b) == (0, 1)
    # Drop the strong reference and force collection to trigger the weakref
    # callback (_clean).
    del a

    assert out.strip() == str(id_a)
    # The freed id is recycled for the next new object.
    c = _WeakObj()
    assert m.get(c) == id_a
    # b still mapped to its original id
    assert m.get(b) == id_b
